title: Chiquita Mushrooms Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Queensland Mushrooms

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
ACCC decided not to oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Chiquita Mushrooms Pty Ltd  - proposed acquisition of Queensland Mushrooms
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was examined within the context of the national market for mushroom growing.  However, it may be that the market includes other vegetables or foods.  It was not necessary to resolve this issue in the current matter.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC did not consider that the proposed acquisition would substantially lessen competition in the relevant market as several large competitors will remain post-acquisition that are capable of supplying mushrooms nationally.
